component.name: NeuroScope
component.summary: Viewer for neurophysiological and behavioral data

description.p: NeuroScope is an advanced viewer for electrophysiological and behavioral data. It displays local field potentials, neuronal spikes, behavioral events and the position of the animal in the environment, and offers limited editing of events.
It is part of Neurosuite together with Klusters and NDManager. Please cite Hazan, Zugaro and Buzsáki (2006), J Neurosci Methods 155:207-216.
